reasons.C01: All dialogue, offscreen roles, important double warning and temporal relation supplied.
reasons.C02: A2 negation reversed; instruction becomes unsafe opposite.
reasons.C03: Meaningful security-failure sound omitted; page legend is not synchronized caption.
reasons.C04: Offscreen question/answer roles not otherwise visible or distinguishable.
reasons.C05: Five-second delay separates warning/answer from relevant scenes; no invented universal numeric limit.
reasons.C06: Static full transcript is not synchronized captions and lacks explicit text-alternative label.
reasons.C07: Actual burned-in captions acceptable; absent HTML track alone does not fail.
reasons.C08: Equivalent condensed A4 preserves saving and invalidation information.
reasons.C09: Explicitly labeled media alternative for full text with no extra information.
reasons.C10: Identical full text does not alone satisfy clearly-labeled exception.
reasons.C11: Extra warning speech invalidates claimed text-alternative exception.
reasons.C12: Only first eight seconds independently observed; later original content unknown.
reasons.C13: Original media retrieval/decode failed; avoid compliance decision from track metadata.
reasons.C14: Complete inventory shows no media within scope.

limits: Controlled synthetic 31.18s, two stable offscreen roles, single important designed sound; no arbitrary diarization/music/noisy-video benchmark.
Models receive source-derived ASR, decoded PNGs, actual browser track observations and declared role legend. Native audio/video evaluation unmeasured.
References are authored before execution; original speech script and expected decisions never included in tested model inputs.
